sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Neutralizing your target is more effective without any noise, from a safe distance. The next test from Sniper is a practice in this kind of business. Get a suppressor and shoot experienced enemies from medium distances."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 PMCs while using a suppressed bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +13,300 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 85,000 Roubles
  - 89,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 97,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

- 1× Mosin Rifle Witt Machine 7.62x54R muzzle brake
- 1× Mosin Rifle Bramit 7.62x54R sound suppressor
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Witt Machine 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL3
- Unlocks craft for 7.62x54mm R BT gzh at Workbench level 3
"The enemy is absolutely helpless when they don't know where they get shot from. You did well, shooter."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Maps with a large number of open spaces where you can effectively engage at 45 m or further such as Woods and Shoreline are recommended for this quest.
